questions.q: Which machine learning algorithm is best for classification problems?
questions.e: A decision tree sorts items into classes, so it fits classification. K-Means and PCA are unsupervised, and linear regression predicts numbers.

questions.q: In cloud computing, what is the primary purpose of elasticity?
o: To dynamically allocate resources as needed
questions.e: Elasticity means resources grow and shrink automatically with demand.

questions.q: Which technique is used in artificial intelligence to enable machines to learn from past experiences?
questions.e: Reinforcement learning improves through rewards and experience from past actions.

questions.q: What is a key advantage of cloud computing?
questions.e: Cloud computing scales easily and you pay for what you use. It still needs the internet and has security risks.
SaaS is Software as a Service.

questions.q: Which service model provides virtualized computing resources?
questions.e: IaaS provides virtual machines, storage and networks.

questions.q: What is a characteristic of cloud elasticity?
questions.e: Elasticity means resources scale up and down on demand.
Docker is the best-known container platform. Containers share the host operating system, unlike virtual machines.

questions.q: Which cloud computing model offers a platform for application development?
questions.e: PaaS gives developers a platform to build and run applications.

o: Applications run without managing underlying servers
questions.e: Serverless means you run code without managing servers. The provider handles them.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of cloud computing?
questions.e: Cloud computing gives scalability, on-demand resources and cost savings. Limited access to applications is not a benefit.

questions.q: What does the term "elasticity" in cloud computing refer to?
o: The ability to recover from disaster
The ability to scale resources up or down based on demand
The ability to run multiple applications on a single server
The ability to store data securely
questions.e: Elasticity is scaling resources up or down with demand.

questions.q: Which of the following cloud service models provides the most control to the user?
questions.e: With IaaS you manage the operating system and software yourself, so you get the most control.

questions.q: What does the term "hybrid cloud" refer to?
o: A cloud service that combines public and private cloud infrastructure
A multi-cloud strategy using different providers
A single data center providing both cloud and on-premise services
A cloud service dedicated to a specific industry
questions.e: A hybrid cloud mixes public and private cloud.

questions.q: Which of the following is a type of supervised learning?
questions.e: Supervised learning uses labelled data. Regression and classification are supervised.

questions.q: What does the term "IoT" stand for?
questions.e: IoT stands for Internet of Things.
